```{=html}
<!-- PAGE HEADER -->
<section class="dm-page-header">
  <div class="dm-container">
    <h1>Contact</h1>
    <p>For project enquiries, training requests, and scoping conversations. We respond to all substantive messages within two working days.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- CONTACT CONTENT -->
<section class="dm-section dm-section--white">
  <div class="dm-container">
    <div class="dm-two-col">

      <!-- LEFT: Meta + guidance -->
      <div>
        <div class="dm-section-header">
          <h2>How to reach us</h2>
        </div>
        

        <div class="dm-section-header dm-mt-40">
          <h2>Enquiries and scope</h2>
          <p>Analytical engagements vary significantly in complexity and governance requirements. An initial message outlining the decision context, available data, timing considerations, and institutional constraints will allow for a focused and efficient discussion. If you’re considering a collaboration, a short note outlining the context is usually enough to begin. The following points help clarify scope and feasibility:</p>
        </div>

        <ol class="dm-guidance-list">
          <li><strong>Objective:</strong> The specific analytical question you need answered, and the decision or output it informs.</li>
          <li><strong>Data available:</strong> What data you have access to, its format, volume, and any governance constraints on its use.</li>
          <li><strong>Deadline:</strong> Any fixed deadlines (regulatory, publication, board) and whether the timeline has flexibility.</li>
          <li><strong>Constraints:</strong> Software environment, output format requirements, confidentiality restrictions, or internal standards that must be met.</li>
          <li><strong>Decision-maker involved:</strong> Who will use the output, and at what level of technical fluency.</li>
        </ol>

        <div class="dm-availability">
          <strong>Current availability:</strong> Accepting new projects for Q2 - Q3 2026 onwards. Training enquiries accepted for any date. Please indicate your preferred start period in your message.
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- RIGHT: Form -->
      <div>
        <div class="dm-section-header">
          <h2>Send a message</h2>
        </div>
        
        <!-- Formspree Form -->
        <form class="dm-form" id="contact-form" action="https://formspree.io/f/mnjbrepp" method="POST">
          <div class="dm-form__group">
            <label class="dm-form__label" for="name">Name</label>
            <input class="dm-form__input" type="text" id="name" name="name" autocomplete="name" placeholder="Your full name">
          </div>
          <div class="dm-form__group">
            <label class="dm-form__label" for="organisation">Organisation</label>
            <input class="dm-form__input" type="text" id="organisation" name="organisation" autocomplete="organization" placeholder="Organisation or institution">
          </div>
          <div class="dm-form__group">
            <label class="dm-form__label" for="email">Email address</label>
            <input class="dm-form__input" type="email" id="email" name="email" autocomplete="email" placeholder="you@organisation.com">
          </div>
          <div class="dm-form__group">
            <label class="dm-form__label" for="message">Message</label>
            <textarea class="dm-form__textarea" id="message" name="message" placeholder="Briefly describe the project or enquiry, including the five points listed opposite where relevant."></textarea>
          </div>
          <button type="submit" class="dm-btn dm-btn--primary">Send message</button>
          <p id="form-feedback" style="display:none; margin-top:12px; font-size:0.875rem; color:var(--dm-teal);"></p>
        </form>
      </div>

    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
document.getElementById('contact-form').addEventListener('submit', function(e) {
  e.preventDefault();

  var name    = document.getElementById('name').value.trim();
  var email   = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
  var message = document.getElementById('message').value.trim();
  var feedback = document.getElementById('form-feedback');
  var btn = this.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');

  if (!name || !email || !message) {
    feedback.textContent = 'Please complete name, email, and message before submitting.';
    feedback.style.color = 'var(--dm-muted)';
    feedback.style.display = 'block';
    return;
  }

  fetch(this.action, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: new FormData(this),
    headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' }
  }).then(function(response) {
    if (response.ok) {
      feedback.textContent = 'Thank you. Your message has been received and will be answered within two working days.';
      feedback.style.color = 'var(--dm-teal)';
      feedback.style.display = 'block';
      btn.disabled = true;
      btn.style.opacity = '0.5';
    } else {
      feedback.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please try again or email us directly.';
      feedback.style.color = 'var(--dm-muted)';
      feedback.style.display = 'block';
    }
  }).catch(function() {
    feedback.textContent = 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again.';
    feedback.style.color = 'var(--dm-muted)';
    feedback.style.display = 'block';
  });
});
</script>
```
